text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} and Monika have made plans to eat together.
text_block_list.orig_text: モニカと食事に来た{0}。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Where is he?
I asked him to get us a table,
but it's a little hard to spot him when it's this crowded.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、どこだ？
席を確保しておくように頼んだが……
こう人が多いと、
探しようがないな。

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't be shy.
Just follow us for a good time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
いいでしょ？
私たちといいコトしましょ～

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Hmm? What's going on here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
なんだ……？
やけに騒がしいな。

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
Aww, you're so cute.
Don't worry, though. We won't bite. Maybe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
照れちゃってかわいい～
ね？　
あたしたちと遊びましょうよ～

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
What's with them?
Trying to hit on someone here doesn't seem ve—
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ、
あの女たちは？
こんな所でナンパとは……

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's {0} they're aiming for!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
声をかけられてるのは{0}か！？

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Your salacious misdeeds end here, I'm afraid!
By which I mean, I have prior arrangements with him already.
I'd rather you not drag him off on some misadventure.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこの女たち、
待て！
そいつは、
私と食事をしに来たのだ。
連れていかれては困る！

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Uhh... What's with this kid?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ～、
なにこの子？

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
Skedaddle off home, brat.
Let the adults have some fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
子供は引っ込んでてくれる？
これは大人の話なのよ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Brat?!
How dare you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な！？
私は子供ではない！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Ignore them, {0}!
They're just silly, overgrown.
No need to pay them any attention!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、こいつらのことは無視しろ！
見た目だけ大人で、
中身が子供の連中など
相手にする必要はないぞ！

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Might want to explain yourself
before we take that the wrong way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？
それ、どういうこと？

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
You might think we'll let you off because you're a kid, 
but I'm afraid not. No one gets away with slandering us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしたちのことバカにしてるの？
子供だからって、
許さないわよ？

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text:
Then again. I guess it makes sense that
a snot-nosed brat wouldn't understand our appeal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お子様には、
私たちの魅力がわからないんでしょうね。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: I've told you once already. Stop treating me like a child!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
子供ではないと言っている！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
I mean. Just look at you.
You're the definition of one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな見た目で言われてもね～
子供にしか見えないわよ？

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
U-urgh...
I'm much more of an adult than either of you!
I'm... I'm even in a r-relationship with {0} here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐ、
ぐぬぬ……
私は立派な大人だ！
{0}とだって……
こ、
恋人同士だからなっ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Shh!
You stay quiet!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しーっ！
貴公は黙っていろ。

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
Are you now?
Sorry, but I find that hard to believe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ～ん、
恋人ねぇ？
本当かしら？
ちょっとウソっぽいわ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
W-well you'll just have to!
{0} and I are the greatest lovers of all time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウ、
ウソではないぞ！
私と{0}は、付き合っている！

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text:
Lovely.
How about you prove that with a kiss, then?
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ～
じゃあ、
キスしてみなさいよ？

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: A-a kiss?!
text_block_list.orig_text: キ、キ、キ、キス……だと！？

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text:
Yup.
A nice, big smooch. Easy, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよ。
本当に恋人なら、
簡単でしょ？

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text:
Come on. Chop chop.
Give him it to him right on the lips.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
どうしたの？
早くキスしてみなさいよ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
U-urgh... This is bad.
I can't k-kiss him. It's too embarrassing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うぅ……
どうすれば……
キ、
キスなんて……
そんな恥ずかしいこと……！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
I don't have much of a choice, though.
My honor is at stake here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし、
やらなければウソがバレてしまう。
それでは、
私の名誉が……！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Don't commence anything!
Why are you so okay with it?!
B-but I can't back down, either...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なぜ乗り気になっている！？
そんなことできるわけが……！
し、
しかし……ここで引くわけにはっ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
N-not in a million years!
Sorry, but I'm afraid you're going to have to deal with this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いや！　
そうはいかない！
貴公には悪いが、
覚悟を決めてもらうぞ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
I have my pride as a soldier. I can't let them trample on that!
We have to... We must k-kiss. At all costs!
text_block_list.orig_text:
子供扱いをされたままでは、
私の名誉が保てない！
{0}……キ、キ、キスッ、
するぞ！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Close your eyes, {0}.
And keep them closed. Understood?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、目をつぶれ……
いいか、
絶対に開けるなよ？

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
C-calm down, me.
I'm not doing this because I want to.
This is just a mission. A mission to protect my honor!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
落ちつけ……
これは本心からのキスではない！
名誉を守るため……
軍人の使命としてのキスだ！

text_block_list.name: Male Customer 1
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? What's the deal here?
Is something going down?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
なんだなんだ？
何かやってるのか？

text_block_list.name: Male Customer 2
text_block_list.text:
Looks like that couple over there's
gonna lay a big fat kiss on each other.
text_block_list.orig_text: あそこのカップルがキスするんだと。

text_block_list.name: Male Customer 1
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, nice!
Get in there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお、いいぞー！
やれやれー！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
W-what the?!
Why do we have an audience all of a sudden?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な！？
い、
いつの間に、
こんなにギャラリーが……！？

text_block_list.name: Onlookers
text_block_list.text:
Give the people what they want!
Kiss! Kiss!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それっ、キース！
キース！　
キース！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... Urgh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
う……うぅ……！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaahhhhh!
Get your eyes off us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁあああ！！
見るな～～～～！！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And thus {0} was knocked
right out of the stratosphere.
text_block_list.orig_text:
照れたモニカに殴り飛ばされ、
星になる{0}であった……
